results.test_desc: Ensure that the API server pod specification file permissions are set to 600 or more restrictive (Automated)
results.remediation:
Run the below command (based on the file location on your system) on the control plane node.
For example, chmod 600 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml
test_info: Run the below command (based on the file location on your system) on the control plane node.
results.expected_result: permissions has permissions 600, expected 600 or more restrictive

results.test_desc: Ensure that the --anonymous-auth argument is set to false (Manual)
results.remediation:
Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the control plane node and set the below parameter.
--anonymous-auth=false

results.test_desc: Ensure that the --profiling argument is set to false (Automated)
results.remediation:
Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the control plane node and set the below parameter.
--profiling=false

results.test_desc: Ensure that the --anonymous-auth argument is set to false (Automated)
results.remediation: If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set `authentication: anonymous: enabled` to `false`.

results.test_desc: Ensure that the --authorization-mode argument is not set to AlwaysAllow (Automated)
results.remediation: If using a Kubelet config file, edit the file to set `authorization.mode` to Webhook.

results.test_desc: Ensure that the cluster-admin role is only used where required (Manual)
results.remediation: Identify all clusterrolebindings to the cluster-admin role. Check if they are used and if they need this role or if they could use a role with fewer privileges.
